title: The Tree Face – The Man in the Tree, 3 Pieces, 5 Faces
seo_title: The Tree Face – A Face for the Tree, 5 Variants
seo_description: A decorative face in three parts for the tree trunk – eyes, nose and mouth. Five expressions to choose from, one per purchase.
descriptionHtml:
The tree in the garden is missing a face

It's that trunk everyone walks past on the way to something more important – the trampoline, the mailbox, the car. Nobody looks up, nobody points, nobody stops. The tree does its job with shade and leaves, and that's exactly what a tree is expected to do.

Three parts, one face – the tree gets an expression

Eyes, nose and mouth are put on the trunk and the tree gets a face. Choose between five expressions: Bearded, Pouty mouth, Mossy smile, Mustache or Wide-eyed – each in three parts. The next time someone walks past, it's not just a tree they see.

Features

  • Five faces to choose from – each face in three parts: eyes, nose and mouth
  • Clearly visible, doesn't disappear into the bark – eyes approx. 5–6 × 4 cm, nose 7–10 cm high, mouth 7–12 cm wide (sizes vary between the faces)
  • The gift for the person who already has everything for the garden – a face on the tree isn't something they've bought themselves
  • What the kids discover on their own – three parts on the trunk are enough for someone to stop and point
  • One face per purchase – Bearded, Pouty mouth, Mossy smile, Mustache or Wide-eyed, you choose which suits the tree

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

Our guarantee

14 days to change your mind – if you don't like it, you get your money back. Tracked delivery and secure checkout. 🦫
